question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Perplex
solution:
The correct answer is "**Simplify**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Perplex" means ****to confuse or puzzle someone.**(उलझाना)
 
 
 
• **Antonym of perplex is simplify, which means to make something easier to understand or do.**(सरल करना)
 
 
• Example: The instructions were so complex that they perplexed the students, but the teacher simplified them and made it easier to understand.
 
 
 
• ​Thus, it can be concluded that the word "simplify" is the antonym of the word "perplex."

​Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: Comprehensive means complete or including everything, which is not an antonym of perplex.(विस्तृत)
 
• Option 2: Complex means difficult or complicated, which is similar to the meaning of perplex.(जटिल)
 
• Option 4: Classify means to arrange or categorize something, which is not an antonym of perplex.(वर्गीकृत)
